www.nowcoder.com.permission_scope: Only exact two publisher-advertised sitemap documents, URL metadata discovery. No article body fetch, child sitemap traversal, hidden APIs or inferred broad terms permission.

www.cnblogs.com.permission_scope: Published RSS subscription invitation: feed metadata/link discovery only. No recursive article fetching or full text storage.
www.cnblogs.com.evidence: Official team RSS invitation; autodriver homepage rel=alternate points to exact feed. Endpoint review by verify_public_collection_endpoints.

zhangzhao219.github.io.permission_scope: Exact article advertises CC BY 4.0 in license-meta; metadata/link discovery only. Attribution: Zhang Zhao, original URL retained.

blog.csdn.net.permission_scope: Publisher explicitly offers RSS订阅 at author homepage. Feed metadata/links only; no articles/paywall fetch.

feed.cnblogs.com.permission_scope: Exact publisher-routed RSS feeds only, metadata discovery; HTTPS mandatory; fresh robots check required.

rss.csdn.net.permission_scope: Exact canonical feed Location from publisher-advertised RSS subscription. Metadata only; fresh robots check required.

api.github.com.permission_scope: Official REST GET contents explicitly allows unauthenticated public resources; exact three user-requested public repositories. Root directory metadata only, no file bodies or recursion.
api.github.com.rate_limit_note: Unauthenticated 60/hour shared IP; serial3 GET maximum plus robots;401/403/429 host pauses; no retries/bypass.
